title: craftable deepslate/cobbeled deepslate
description: just craftable deepslate and cobbeled deepslate. nothing else
body: This vanilla-friendly data pack adds a simple custom crafting recipe to Minecraft. It allows players to tightly pack a full 3x3 grid of regular Cobblestone inside a standard crafting table to instantly create a block of Cobbled Deepslate. It provides a logical and fast way to renew deepslate resources in survival.
